root_cause.text: The `nouveau_connector_aux_xfer` function did not verify the runtime power state of the device before attempting DisplayPort AUX transfers, permitting operations on a suspended device that triggered a crash in the GSP subsystem.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `if (pm_runtime_suspended(nv_connector->base.dev->dev)) return -EBUSY;` to `nouveau_connector_aux_xfer`, resolving the issue described in the CVE where accessing `/dev/drm_dp_*` during runtime suspend caused a warning and crash in `r535_gsp_msgq_wait`.
